rationale: The five-person Himalayan raspberry series reports lower blood pressure over time and mild asymptomatic low readings in three participants. Medication adjustments and uncertain species, preparation and posture limit transfer. No measured lightheadedness comparison has been verified for frozen raspberry in Parkinson disease.

The small Parkinson and non-Parkinson associations use ungraded olive oil and have confounding and multiplicity limits. DieTBra compares active dietary programs, and MEDI-PD's anxiety interaction is inconclusive (p=.745). AU-ARROW plans DASS in a multidomain intervention with extra-virgin oil. The minimal lean for cold-pressed oil still rests on the earlier observational findings.

An egg-recipe trial found no clear effect on a physical performance composite that included an eight-foot walk. Two Parkinson studies list eggs among many foods. The recent observational abstract associates weekly egg intake with osteosarcopenia and gives gait results by diagnosis. An egg-specific walking estimate remains open.

An author abstract reports a larger dysarthria score change after adding an egg-yolk-derived oil to standard care in people with hemiplegia. The administration route and individual speech measures await the original. A poached-egg speech intelligibility effect in Parkinson disease remains unresolved.

A small paprika xanthophyll study favored lower post-exercise fatigue. Separate capsule registrations leave participant fatigue open. The capsinoid cycling comparison supplies metabolic findings and leaves patient-rated fatigue open. Direction for raw bell pepper and Parkinson fatigue remains unresolved.

The KIM trial phases encouraged unspecified olive oil and its insomnia event concerned an overall diet. A cannabis series recorded a within-dose insomnia change with shared ungraded olive oil. AU-ARROW plans the Insomnia Severity Index within a multidomain program using extra-virgin oil. A Parkinson insomnia effect specific to the oil remains open.

Mean fatigue severity rose 3.7 points in 14 Parkinson study completers after three months of brewed green tea. The same-cohort thesis lacks paired participant scores or an exact p-value. This uncontrolled direction supports a minimal worsening lean. A postoperative randomized trial favored less fatigue in a different setting. The fly report gives isolated EGCG and locomotor outcomes.
